visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a dark sleeveless blouse and a thin necklace, sits at a wooden desk with a white mouse and a mechanical keyboard. Behind her is a bookshelf with small plants, books, and a YouTube creator award. She looks frustrated while yellow and white text overlays her chest. (2) The camera zooms in on her face as she appears increasingly annoyed. She is holding a white mug in one hand and a smartphone in the other, listening to a message while looking at a computer screen. (3) A title card appears with text indicating common designer grievances. The scene cuts back to the woman at her desk, still interacting with her phone and looking exasperated. (4) A second character, a person wearing glasses, a blue button-down shirt, and a tie (played by the same actress), enters the frame holding a light blue tumbler. They point toward the computer screen while the first woman works, looking drained. (5) A third character with long dark hair and a white t-shirt (also played by the same actress) enters the frame holding a stack of papers, appearing to ask for a favor with a forced smile. (6) The original woman character at the desk becomes overwhelmed, slamming her hands on the table and yelling at the ceiling while red flame graphics surround her. She then stands up abruptly, leaving the frame. (7) The scene transitions to a brightly lit studio setting showing a grey ergonomic office chair from several angles. (8) Close-up shots highlight specific features of the chair: the mesh backrest, the lumbar support adjustment, the 3D armrests, and the seat tilting mechanism. The woman is seen sitting in the chair in different outfits, demonstrating comfort. (9) A split-screen shot shows the woman as the boss character and the designer character sitting together in the chairs. (10) The woman is shown assembling the chair by attaching the headrest and backrest using a tool. (11) The final scene returns to the office bookshelf setting where the designer and the boss character interact again, with the designer looking skeptically at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Comedic, bouncy background music starts with a high-pitched 'boing' sound effect. A female voice speaks at a fast, slightly stressed pace. (2) A muffled telephone voice filter is heard over the BGM, representing a caller. Sharp 'ping' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the conversation. (3) The female voice shifts to a lower-pitched, authoritative 'boss' persona, speaking with exaggerated emphasis. Percussive drum beats sync with visual cuts. (4) A high-pitched female voice enters, speaking in a wheedling, pleading tone. There are rapid-fire speech segments followed by a loud 'thud' sound representing a desk slam. (5) The woman screams at a high volume and high pitch, followed by a 'whoosh' transition effect. (6) The BGM shifts to an upbeat, bright acoustic track. A calm, professional female voice narrates the features of the chair with clear articulation and moderate tempo. (7) Mechanical clicking sounds are heard as the chair is adjusted. (8) The comedic BGM returns for the final scene, ending with a final witty dialogue exchange and a sharp cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the common frustrations and physical toll of being a professional graphic designer, ultimately positioning the SIDIZ ergonomic chair as the essential solution for physical comfort and mental endurance in a demanding work environment.
